issue_fields.category: One of: C-代码Bug, E-环境问题, D-依赖缺失, P-平台兼容, M-模型缺失, S-跳过问题
issue_fields.affected_tests: List of test IDs or count of affected tests
issue_fields.first_seen: Date when issue was first detected (YYYY-MM-DD)
issue_fields.last_seen: Date when issue was last observed (YYYY-MM-DD)
issue_fields.fix_commit: Git commit hash if fixed, null otherwise

category_descriptions.C-代码Bug: vLLM code defects - AssertionError, TypeError in vLLM code
category_descriptions.E-环境问题: Environment limits - OSError, FileNotFoundError, quota errors
category_descriptions.P-平台兼容: PyTorch API compatibility - wrap_triton, fp32_precision, ABI errors
category_descriptions.M-模型缺失: HF models not downloaded - LocalEntryNotFoundError, config.json missing
